_comment: Reviewed, intentional layout changes against the committed snapshots (scripts/check_storage_layout.py).

shrink by exactly the appended slots, or a moved end slot) fails the gate.

(25 -> 24, end slot 65 unchanged); its structs moved from SuperPaymaster to the shared
SuperPaymasterStorage base (declaring-scope rename only: every member slot/offset/type is compared).

baseline_sha256 pins the snapshot file itself: `update` alone makes the gate fail until the pin is changed in the same reviewed change.
